statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail is in the low band at 19% while Stress stays elevated at 48% into quadruple-witching expiry.
recommendation: Observed structure is a mild upward grind inside a tight overnight band with cross-assets de-escalating, so Tail remains below the block threshold. Conditional risk is concentrated in the 13:30Z-15:00Z window, where Industrial Production, the Bowman speech and the US cash open coincide on expiry day, and secondarily at the 20:00Z settlement.
headline: NQ fades a fresh 29,966.75 session high back to ~29,910 as falling oil and a softer VIX keep cross-assets de-escalating into quadruple-witching expiry
body: Nasdaq-100 cash closed Thursday at 29,446.98, up 1.73% (+501.92 points), in a relief rally after Wednesday's unanimous 25bp Federal Reserve hike to 3.75-4.00%, the first US increase in more than three years. The Bank of Japan then raised its policy rate 25bp to 1.25% at 02:45Z, a 31-year high, on a 7-2 vote, and Governor Ueda's press conference from 06:30Z restated a data-dependent path without signalling acceleration. The yen has weakened rather than strengthened since: USD/JPY trades at 157.80, up 1.19% and at the top of its 155.864-157.841 daily range. A weaker yen after a hike is the opposite of a carry unwind, so the transmission channel that makes a central-bank second leg dangerous for mean-reversion strategies is not active. NQ December futures trade near 29,909.75, about +0.56%, having printed a fresh session high at 29,966.75 within the past hour and faded roughly 57 points from it; the fade has held, which is a failed extension rather than a no-retracement path. The overnight band is 29,648.00-29,966.75, about 1.07% wide, and price sits in its upper portion, which supports a trend-up read but not an aligned one-way structure. ES trades +0.29% against NQ at +0.56%, so the leadership is tech-specific rather than a broad index thrust. Cross-assets are de-escalating: WTI has fallen to $95.48, down 1.80% and declining for a fourth consecutive session as Saudi Arabia moves to restore about half the capacity of its drone-damaged East-West pipeline within days; VIX trades at 15.19, down 1.62% with a 14.99-15.20 range; and the 10-year Treasury yield sits near 4.93% after retreating roughly 10bp on Thursday from 19-year highs. Falling oil, a softening VIX and stabilising yields remove the amplifiers that would otherwise support a persistent no-retracement path, which is why high Stress coexists with a low-band Tail. Delayed latest-session context shows Thursday's breadth was strongly aligned, with all eight tracked megacaps higher and semiconductors up a mean 5.0%, but that is prior-session performance, not evidence of live directional structure. The day's structural feature is the September quadruple-witching expiration, which settles at the 20:00Z cash close, with August Industrial Production at 13:15Z, a Fed Bowman speech at 13:30Z and the CB Leading Index at 14:00Z framing the US open. Conditional risk is therefore concentrated in the 13:30Z-15:00Z window, where opening continuation on an already-extended index is either confirmed or rejected. CME equity futures halt for the weekend from 21:00Z, after which no live price path exists and Tail falls to the low-band floor.

lookbackSummary: Over the past 24 hours Tail ranged 17-26% and Stress decayed from 62% to the low 40s before ticking back toward 50% around the BOJ decision. The single orange hour was 13:00Z Thursday at the US cash open, where trend-up structure was most pronounced; Tail fell back through the afternoon as retracements reappeared. From 22:00Z the overnight hours settled into a normal, range-bound mode with Tail 17-18% and Confidence near 87%, and that regime held through the BOJ statement and the Ueda press conference without a disorderly repricing. The 07:00Z hour returned to a trend-up read as NQ pressed the top of its band.
outlookSummary: The next 24 hours carry one narrow conditional-risk peak. Tail holds in the low band through the European morning, then moves into the watch band at 11:00Z as US pre-market positioning builds for quadruple-witching expiry. It reaches 23% at 13:00Z, where Industrial Production, the Bowman speech and the cash open coincide, and the single hour mapped to BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES is 14:00Z at Tail 25%, covering the window in which opening continuation is confirmed or rejected. Tail then eases through the US afternoon, with a secondary Stress peak at the 20:00Z quadruple-witching settlement. From 21:00Z the CME weekend halt removes any live price path, so Tail falls to 12-15% and Confidence eases into the solid band for the remaining slots.
